stemMd: A school wants to estimate the fraction of all students who cycle to school. Which sampling plan best avoids selecting students based on transport choice?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Select students at random from the complete enrolment list.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Survey only students arriving on school buses.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Ask for volunteers in the cycling club.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Survey only students at the bicycle racks.

explanationMd: Random selection from the complete student list gives all students a chance independent of their commuting mode. The other plans condition selection on transport-related behaviour.

distractorRationale.c: Membership and willingness to respond can bias the sample.
